svg.title: Lloyd's method settles in 4 iterations: the total squared distance falls from 153.5 to 10.8 and then stops changing.
svg.desc: Four scatter plots of the same eighteen points, one per iteration. Cluster membership is shown by marker shape — disc, square and triangle — as well as colour, and each centroid is drawn as a large open cross with its cluster number beside it. In the first panel the centroids sit where the random initialisation put them and the clusters cut across the three visible blobs. By the last panel each centroid sits at the middle of one blob and no point changes cluster, which is the stopping condition. The inertia printed under each panel falls and then levels off.
svg.text: k-means with k = 3, Forgy initialisation from seed 4221

g.text: Cluster membership is a marker SHAPE as well as a colour; the 2025 k-means view used colour alone.
Inertia can only fall. If a redraw ever shows it rising, the implementation is wrong.
